story: The founders of wahl.chat are from Munich and originally came together in Cambridge, UK, to do joint research on AI. We're now spread across several countries, but we still share one goal: with wahl.chat, we want to contribute to democracy by making politics more accessible. Based on the parties' manifestos, plenary records and voting behaviour, we offer a simple, source-backed way to get informed – and rethink political education along the way.
